card.name: Cross-references to Warnings and Precautions
card.fires_on: The last pieces of the cross-reference phrase "[see Warnings and Precautions (5.x)]" in drug labels, such as the end of "Precautions", "Populations" or the closing parenthesis. It also fires on word endings inside nearby section headings.

modes.label: Inside the cross-reference
modes.description: The ending of "Precautions" or "Populations" within a bracketed "see" reference, just before the section number.
modes.example: known hypersensitivity to nemolizumab-ilto or to any of the excipients in NEMLUVIO [ see Warnings and Preca<<utions>> (5.1) ].

modes.label: Closing parenthesis of section number
modes.description: The ")" that closes a section number such as (5.1) before the closing bracket.
modes.example: History of seizure [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1<<)>> ] Moderate or severe renal impairment (Cr

modes.label: Ends of heading words
modes.description: The final piece of a longer heading word such as WARNINGS or Myelosuppression, in a list of reactions or contraindications.
modes.example: CONTRAINDICATIONS Pregnancy Category X See Boxed CONTRAINDICATIONS AND WARN<<INGS>> .

card.writes: It seems to push toward line breaks and closing punctuation, and away from unrelated words, so the model expects the reference to end.
card.plain: It marks the end of the "see Warnings and Precautions (5.x)" pointers in a drug label.
